semantic.justification: Task200 connects numeric ODFF source to real ScTokenArray/shared FormulaCompiler RPN, ScInterpreter and existing ScFormulaResult inside the actual document-sheet-column formula blocks. Native scalar arithmetic precedence, code/runtime error projection, lazy result state, default bracket completion, forced recalc and logical formula-block events are represented. ScSheetLimits, RTL parsing/cancellation, mdds and shared token/result owners are reused. Formula pointers use JS GC; no physical pointer deletion or reference counting is introduced. Source constructor/service subsets are explicit. References/functions, localized formatter/string conversion, groups/listening/recalc dependencies, serialization/ODS/UI, complete contexts/RNG/caches/vector/hash scheduling and broad parity remain unsupported. Native power fenv-only subnormal classifications reject explicitly. Formula block copy/clone is noncopyable and unavailable semantic equality throws instead of substituting identity. Broad parity/verification flags remain false. Task201 implements valid same-sheet ODFF A1 references through actual ScSingleRefData/ScSingleRefToken/RPN, borrowed document/formula cell views and numeric/empty/direct-text results. Actual shared Svt observers, typed broadcaster stores and native logical FormulaTrack/FormulaTree queues propagate edits and remove subscriptions on replacement/clear. Default dirty context is -1/-1/false; normal noniterative cycles return522; forced/manual modes and inserted-sheet positions are represented. Broad native constructor/service parity remains unverified. JS GC owns physical lifetime; Dispose closes semantic subscriptions/queues only. Cross-sheet/external/range/named references, functions, locale string-to-number conversion, area/group/iteration/deep-recursion services, full context/formatting, formula serialization, ODS and UI remain unsupported. These are bounded implementation slices, not broad native parity. Task203 implements native ScHorizontalCellIterator row-major traversal over actual shared mdds const block cursors,with original column-parameter vector,SkipInvalidInRow/FindNextNonEmptyRow order,stable borrowed result owner,inclusive area bounds and original allocated-column clamp. Native GetCellStore/ClampToAllocatedColumns and toRefCell provide the same real typed values used by editing. No cell grid,snapshot,priority heap or alternate document model is created;formula cells are not evaluated by iteration. Only existing sheets,valid typed-store area coordinates and numeric/string/formula/empty block families are supported. SetTab retains the constructor column clamp and requires that allocated-column domain on the next sheet;out-of-domain input rejects explicitly rather than creating columns. Rich edit text,all other dociter families,full document services,ODS filters and UI remain unported. JS GC owns physical lifetime;native borrowed-result and iterator invalidation preconditions remain caller responsibilities. Broad native contract/behavior/default parity is not certified. Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity. TaskWP2DC4 connects the actual shared Writer FontSizeSelect through Calc FontHeight slot10015 and ScFormatShell to real document/sheet/column/default-column ScAttrArray runs, ScPatternAttr and shared itemsets. Original height200twips100percent defaults and three-script font-size application are retained. Real ScUndoSelectionAttr stores an attribute-only ScDocument plus marks and redo delta; content remains in original cell stores. Automatic ODF cell styles preserve script font heights and styled empty row/column spans through actual package/autosave/open. ScDocumentPool exports only original contiguous character prefix100..124; no defaults are invented for unsupported cell/page items. Default fonts use source script-language fallbacks, shipped configuration and original no-device OnlyOne logical-family branch without claiming installed faces. Full native format/dialog/script-aware painting,automatic row height,named cell styles,family application and remaining cell/page defaults remain unverified. Writer visible-content/two-word naming,primary storage and no-recovery deviations remain. This leaf does not certify complete Calc UI parity. TaskGKVVR7 connects source standard automatic row-height arithmetic and genuine compressed geometry/flags to current FontHeight UI and attribute Undo/Redo. Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified. Task89YNKC connects native grow/shrink slots11042/11043, complete typed font-height requests and shared SvxScriptSetItem to real script-specific selection patterns, attribute history, ODS and browser glyph spans. Native mixed/default/invalid states, unsigned growth/signed shrink limits, metadata reset, identical-format history, disjoint marks and whole-sheet data-area query clipping are retained. Default formatobjectbar Grow/Shrink placements remain hidden as upstream. Existing Writer font/menu/toolbar controls and primary-save/open/no-recovery deviations remain. Native rich edit, filtered/alternate sheet views, device text metrics, full pool-cache/border services and complete application parity are not claimed.
